ruins.name: Gull Buffet
ruins.clue: The gull is a drop zone too. Share your chips with it and watch the whole flock RSVP.

ruins.name: Spin Doctor
ruins.clue: Signposts are only screwed on so tight. Eight turns in one go and it takes off.

ruins.name: Travel Light
ruins.clue: There is a third way to close a suitcase. It involves owning nothing.

ruins.name: Dinner Bell
ruins.clue: Bossworth swears the bell brings fish. Ring it five times and something big does turn up.

ruins.name: Return to Sender
ruins.clue: He begged you not to stamp him. A stamp sticks to anything, including narrators.
